answer: The forme either prints clean or the sheet comes off smeared, and the printer proofs every page before the run begins. Proof of printer press via printers guild is a press of that kind: a press the printers guild stamps only after the printer pulls a sheet he actually set. The vine climbs the press-room wall, and the type bites the paper or it slips. 17 invented presses take 17 printers and 17 editions the printer never set; the canyon between the lines is the gap where the type never bit, and a raven circles the bindery where the unprinted sheets wait.
